description: Save which projects the user wants watched for new tools, e.g. 'my Next.js SaaS: auth, deploy, payments'. Use after subscribe, or when the user says they started/finished a project or changed interests. Replaces the whole list each time, so send all projects. Inputs: `key`; `projects` [{name, interests: short tags}]; `mode` 'by_interests' (only matching new tools) or 'all_new' (every new tool). Returns ok, project count, mode. Only whats_new reads this; it never changes search or recommendations.

key.description: the user's anonymous feed key from subscribe

mode.description: 'by_interests' (only matching new tools) or 'all_new' (every new tool)

projects.description: list of projects to watch (replaces the whole list each time)

name: save_preferences
title: Save your preferences
